fields.System.Title: OUT-104 — Cancel an order and release reservations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want to cancel an order and have its stock returned to
availability, so that cancelling does not quietly make stock unsellable forever.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an allocated order, when I cancel it, then every reservation is released in
  • the same transaction and availability increases accordingly.
  • - Given an order being picked, then cancellation is allowed and the open pick tasks are
  • cancelled too.
  • - Given a shipped order, then cancellation is rejected — use a return instead.
  • - Given cancellation from any entry point (API, ERP, wave cancel, timeout), then the
  • same release path runs.
  • - Given cancellation, then outbound.order_cancelled is published.
  • - Given cancellation, then no reservation row for that order remains open.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | order, reservation, stock_balance, pick_task |
| Risks | Reservation leak ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration (per entry point) · invariant · rollback |
